utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies list underway, and I’ll share the missing items and meeting spot as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Cleo—I'll keep folks posted once you confirm the missing items and meeting spot. I’m happy to help coordinate the drop-off details too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — I’ll confirm the missing items and exact meeting spot, then send you the details. Appreciate you helping with the drop-off coordination.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — I’m still putting the supply list together, and we could use a few more tool-savvy volunteers for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — and do you know the exact meeting spot for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet — I’m still confirming the spot, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep the front door latch as the priority and check the kitchen sink if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — I really appreciate it. The latch is the main thing, and the sink can wait if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll keep the latch first and only check the sink if time allows.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can help sort the tools and tidy the sign-up list when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — that’d be a big help. I’ve got a few usable tools ready, and I can bring them by as soon as you’re set with the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great — I’m set, so you can bring the tools by when you’re ready. I’ll sort them and keep the sign-up list in order.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive invite and send the meeting spot as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate it — I’ll send the details as soon as I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll keep sharing the repair drive invite and send the meeting spot over as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m checking the school schedule now, and I’ll send you a time that avoids pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — that sounds good. I’ll keep the repair drive set and wait for your time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll send you a time as soon as I confirm the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — just let me know when the list’s ready, and I’ll help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — I’ll let you know as soon as the list’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate it. Just give me a shout when it’s ready, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — please keep me posted on any changes, and I’ll keep the repair drive setup moving.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — I’ll keep an eye on the tool list and pickup timing, and let you know if anything’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks, Pia — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the setup moving, and please let me know if anything on the tool list changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, I’m still sorting the list and I’ll be there early to help organize everything. If you’ve got any extra tape, markers, or sturdy boxes, bring them along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll bring tape, markers, and a couple sturdy boxes. Let’s keep the urgent repair stuff at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll keep the urgent repairs at the top and sort the rest after that. Thanks for bringing those supplies; I’ll see you early.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, thanks — a quick list would really help me keep track. We can start with Nell’s latch first and see if there’s time for the sink too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll pass that along and keep folks focused on Nell’s latch first, with the sink as a backup if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — that works for me. I’m grateful you’re keeping everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, Leo — I’m ready with my gloves and tools, just send me the job list and I’ll take the housing-blocking repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ll send the job list and be there early to sort. Thanks, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll be ready early too, and I’ll focus on the housing-blocking repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Rosa—you’re really okay helping with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Kira — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. We’ve moved it to Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list sorted by urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll be there on Sunday at the community center, right?
